caption: Shirley nearly tripled during Shirley Temple's breakthrough, then fell from 42,366 in 1935 to 133 in 2025. #Shirley #NameHistory #AIVoice
pinned_comment: Which star moved a name the most?
story_thesis: Shirley rose from 14,320 births in 1933 to a 42,366 peak in 1935 during Shirley Temple's breakthrough, then fell to 133 by 2025.
script: This name nearly tripled in two years. Shirley went from 14,320 girls in 1933 to 42,366 in 1935. Shirley Temple won a juvenile Academy Award in 1935. By 2025: 133. Watch two years change everything.
